dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple elliptical and irregular circular structures with high-contrast light perimeters surrounding darker core pixels; most prominent are three 'O' shaped structures in the mid-lateral region and a horizontally elongated 'C' shaped structure in the lower central quadrant with soft gradient transitions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of localized, high-intensity white pixel clusters concentrated primarily in the anterior dorsal region and intermittently along the lower ventral-lateral margin.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the four most prominent central annuli form an irregular convex quadrilateral, while three high-intensity blobs in the anterior section form an obtuse scalene triangle.
